title: UCP Discount Extension Schema
description: Defines discount codes and applied promotion structures extending UCP checkout sessions.

discounts.description: Discount inputs and calculated promotions for the checkout session.

codes.description: Promotional or coupon codes submitted by the buyer.

applied.description: Discounts successfully calculated and applied to the session total.

code.description: Coupon or rule code triggering this promotion.

title.description: Buyer-facing title or summary of the savings.

amount.description: Total discount savings in minor currency units (e.g. cents).

target_line_item_ids.description: Line items receiving this discount allocation, if applicable.
